title: A field guide to tea
summary: Sixteen teas as specimens: find one, read its flavour and how to brew it.

all_ids.sql: SELECT id FROM teas ORDER BY no

teas.sql: SELECT * FROM teas WHERE ($kind IS NULL OR kind = $kind) ORDER BY no

profile.sql: SELECT n.note, n.score, avg(f.score) AS family_avg FROM notes n JOIN teas t ON t.id = n.tea_id JOIN teas ft ON ft.kind = t.kind JOIN notes f ON f.tea_id = ft.id AND f.note = n.note WHERE n.tea_id = $pick GROUP BY n.note, n.score, n.ord ORDER BY n.ord
